claims.quote: The red-line torpedo barb, Dawkinsia denisonii, is a cyprinid endemic to Kerala and Karnataka in southern India.
Until now, S. denisonii was collected only in the state of Kerala, India.

regions.name: Manimala River
regions.quote: Type locality is 'Mundakayam, Travancore, India', which appears to correspond to the Manimala River near the town of Mundakayam in Kottayam District, Kerala state, southern India.

regions.name: Valapatanam
regions.quote: Its modern distribution is highly fragmented with small populations remaining in the Valapatanam, Chaliyar, Kallar, Karyangod, Kuttiyadi, Chandragiri, Sullya, Kuppam, Iritti, Anjarakandipuzha, Bhavani, and Bharatapuzha river systems.
